description: UC Santa Cruz + China intl with highSchoolLocation set + strong RD (regression: original 4/26 prod returned 19% due to geo+intl double-penalty)
rationale: UCSC uses official 2024-25 CDS C1 data: overall admit rate 65.57%, international admit rate 77.06%, and geo is skipped for international applicants. Under v1.3+ counselor logic, the GPA × SAT compounding is replaced by their geometric mean to avoid double-counting correlated signals — a strong applicant (3.9/1500) still gets a meaningful boost above the school anchor but no longer pushes to the absolute 98% cap. The expanded range [0.55, 0.85] still catches the original PR-8 bug (intl × OOS double-penalty produced ~19%) while accepting the v1.3 geometric-mean behavior. This case must use highSchoolLocation: 'CN' to specifically trigger the old bug path.
